podcast.body: The third hit single from the "Let's Dance" album, produced by Nile Rogers as "Debenair Jet Setting Dance Rock." It reached number 14 on the Hot 100, enabling "Let's Dance" to overcome the barrier of having only two hits and becoming Bowie's first album to generate three hits. The video captured Bowie live on stage on his "Serious Moonlight" tour, portraying him as a sleek, "up-ified pop idol" in a yellow suit with a Little Richard-style pompadour. "Let's Dance overcame that barrier too, when Modern Love, produced by Nile Rogers as Debenair Jet Setting Dance Rock, reached number 14 on the Hot 100."

podcast.body: This song was performed by David Bowie in Prague on June 23, 2004, when he returned to the stage after a brief exit following initial signs of a heart attack. "Then he returned to sing China Girl and Modern Love."
